fields.subject: Core Log Events
fields.trigger: code elsewhere in the library calls one of the eight cache-hit/cache-miss wrapper methods on the logger for a model type — SqlInParametersCacheHit/Miss, SqlSetOutParametersCacheHit/Miss, SqlReadOutParametersCacheHit/Miss, or SqlReaderCacheHit/Miss
fields.response: report whether that model type's compiled mapping delegate was already cached (Trace-level cache-hit) or had to be compiled (Debug-level cache-miss) under event id MapperCacheStatus, with an event name equal to the wrapper method's name and a message naming the cache kind — input parameters, setting output parameters, reading output parameters, or data reader — and the model type as the cache key
fields.postcondition: each of the four cache kinds is distinguishable by event name and message
